newsitem.title: USA: US Labor Dept economist sees 3 pct inflation--RFTV.
newsitem.headline: US Labor Dept economist sees 3 pct inflation--RFTV.

text.p: U.S. Labor Department economist Ken Stewart said Wednesday inflation remains in the three percent range and that it would be "speculation" to suggest the latest data showed a shift in that trend.

"I think the trend remains in the three percent range," Stewart said in an interview with Reuters Financial Televison following the release of a Labor Department report showing a 0.3 percent rise in consumer prices in September.

Stewart said the pickup in prices last month, which followed a more modest 0.1 percent rise in the Consumer Price Index in August, was due more to special factors -- increases in clothing, new cars -- than an overall underlying trend.
"I think that this month is due more to special factors than any change in trend," Stewart said.
A continuation of the 0.3 percent monthly CPI increase would result in an annual rate of 3.6 percent, Stewart said.
"That would represent a new trend, but I think at this point that is just speculation," he said.
